serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Trust me. I have a feeling that Melissa’s situation is more complicated and that’s why she’s acting the way she does.
Bot: Or she’s just programmed that way. Chances are high that she’s just doing whatever she’s told to.
You: If that turns out to be true, I will go and talk with her owner. {{wi}}She has an owner, right?
Bot: She’s got to. Unlike me, she’s a commercially sold bot, so after the anti-bot law was passed, she wouldn’t be around anymore if she didn’t have a master.
You: That’s good to know. 
You: How about we all go bowling? This time it would be me, Annalie, you and Melissa. Would that be ok with you?
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: Alright.
I hate quarreling with her, but in the end I’m doing it for her.
I can’t just give up on Melissa only because of her sharp tongue and if her owner really is pulling the strings behind the scenes, that’s, for me, just another reason to help her.
There are not many bots like Melissa around anymore. If I can’t make it work, who knows when another chance will come across.
